scripts.deploy: pnpm turbo run build --filter @prisma/example-queues... && ( set -a; . "${PRISMA_DEPLOY_ENV:-../../.env}"; set +a; bun node_modules/.bin/prisma-composer deploy module.ts ${QUEUES_STACK_NAME:+--name "$QUEUES_STACK_NAME"} )
scripts.destroy: ( set -a; . "${PRISMA_DEPLOY_ENV:-../../.env}"; set +a; bun node_modules/.bin/prisma-composer destroy module.ts --production ${QUEUES_STACK_NAME:+--name "$QUEUES_STACK_NAME"} )
